sources: assets/info/ccc_motor_guide.pdf (MOTOR Guide to Estimating, 148 pages, Rev 11-25)
_meta.description: CCC ONE / MOTOR estimate PDF 解析规则手册。后端解析时按 Stage 顺序执行。

stage_1_format_detection._comment: 第一步：判断估价格式类型，决定后续解析策略

FORMAT_A.label: Estimate / Final Bill
FORMAT_A.note: Operation 列通常不缩写，直接写 Remove/Replace, Repair, Remove/Install, Blend

FORMAT_B.label: Estimate of Record / Preliminary / Supplement
FORMAT_B.note: Oper 列使用大量缩写，需要执行 Stage 3 缩写展开

FORMAT_B_WITH_SUMMARY.label: Supplement ... with Summary
FORMAT_B_WITH_SUMMARY.critical_rule: 标题含 'with Summary' 代表包含多个 Supplement 汇总。必须只读取 GRAND TOTAL / SUPPLEMENT SUMMARY 部分，禁止重复累加各分页行项，避免 overlap。

stage_2_document_structure._comment: 第二步：识别文档结构层次

group_headings.description: Group Headings 由 MOTOR 数据库自动生成，全大写，不含 action 动词，token count <= 6。遇到时更新 activeGroup 上下文。
group_headings.detection_pattern: line is ALL_CAPS AND no action verb (replace/repair/blend/refinish) AND token count <= 6

stage_3_abbreviation_normalization._comment: 第三步：术语标准化。FORMAT_A 基本不需要，FORMAT_B 必须执行。

line_symbols.#: Manual line entry - estimator added, not from MOTOR DB
line_symbols.*: MOTOR DB line modified by estimator (price, description, or labor time changed)
line_symbols.**: Database line with Aftermarket part A/M

stage_4_operation_extraction._comment: 第四步：提取有效维修操作。核心提取逻辑。

line_note_semantic_overrides._comment: Line Notes 会对同一行的 Oper 语义进行覆盖。必须优先解读 notes 再判断操作类型。

rules.interpretation: partial R/I (remove and drop only, not repair and refinish). 不计入结构修复操作，不触发耗材。

rules.example: rpr qtr glass 0.3B — note: rope / rpr w'shield — note: rope
rules.interpretation: 使用 rope 方式部分 R/I 玻璃，不是完整修复/喷漆工序。不触发耗材。
该操作已包含在另一行工时内，不重复计算。
有折旧扣减，记录 betterment 百分比，不影响耗材识别。

stage_5_filter_rules._comment: 第五步：过滤不触发耗材的行。命中任意一条即跳过。

always_skip.reason: 外委工序，不使用本店耗材

always_skip.condition: action is ONLY Blend or Refinish, no Replace/Repair/Remove/Install/Weld/Section
always_skip.reason: 纯 blend/refinish 无结构操作，不触发结构耗材
该操作工时已包含在主操作内，不重复

always_skip.condition: negative labor value AND description contains overlap
always_skip.reason: CCC ONE 自动产生的扣减行，不是独立操作

always_skip.condition: line is under OTHER CHARGES section
always_skip.reason: 拖车、存储、EPC 等，不触发结构耗材

always_skip.condition: Labor Type is D Diagnostic or E Electrical
always_skip.reason: 诊断/电气操作不使用碰撞修复耗材

always_skip.condition: Description contains tire OR wheel alignment OR wheel balance OR alignment check
always_skip.reason: 轮胎/四轮定位不使用碰撞耗材

always_skip.condition: Labor Type is M AND component classification is (m)
always_skip.reason: 纯机械部件维修不需要碰撞类耗材

always_skip.condition: operation is R&I on glass AND Line Notes contains rope
always_skip.reason: rope 方式 R/I 玻璃无焊接/切割需求

always_skip.condition: Description contains any of: weatherstrip, emblem, nameplate, molding clip, bracket bolt, lamp bulb, reflector, trim clip, garnish clip
always_skip.reason: 小件 R&I 不触发大类耗材

always_skip.condition: Oper is D&R only (Disconnect and Reconnect)
always_skip.reason: D&R 工时已包含在主操作内，不独立触发耗材

always_skip.condition: Description contains camera aiming OR sensor aiming
always_skip.reason: ADAS 校准操作不触发碰撞耗材

always_skip.condition: Description contains frame machine setup OR frame machine set-up
always_skip.reason: 钢架机调设不触发结构耗材

stage_6_operation_canonicalization._comment: 第六步：操作规范化为标准 canonical key，用于匹配 material_logic.csv

stage_7_confidence_scoring._comment: 第七步：为提取出的操作评分。高置信走规则引擎，低置信走 LLM 兜底。

HIGH.routing: 直接 material_logic.csv 匹配，不调用 LLM

MEDIUM.routing: 先规则匹配，失败则发候选行+上下文给 LLM

LOW.routing: 发该行+前后1行+group 给 LLM，附 system_prompt_v1

stage_8_llm_fallback._comment: 第八步：LLM 兜底策略。只在低/中置信触发，只发必要上下文，控制 token 成本。
stage_8_llm_fallback.system_prompt: You are a CCC ONE collision repair estimate parser. Your task is to identify repair operations from estimate line items. CCC ONE estimates use two formats: (1) Estimate/Final Bill with full operation names; (2) Estimate of Record/Supplement with abbreviations (Repl=Replace, Rpr=Repair, R&I=Remove Install, R&R=Remove Replace, Refn=Refinish, Blnd=Blend, Subl=Sublet). Extract ONLY structural repair operations relevant to consumable materials. SKIP: Sublet, cosmetic-only Blend/Refinish without structural action, lines noted drop or rope, Incl. lines, diagnostic/electrical/glass operations, camera/sensor aiming, D&R only lines. Return JSON only: {"operations": [{"canonical": string, "action": string, "location": string, "confidence": number}]}
token_control_rules: 发送候选行而非整份 PDF 文本
context window: 前1行 + 当前行 + 后1行 + activeGroup
同 group 内同类操作合并为一次请求
相同 PDF hash 命中缓存，不重复调用
每份估价最多 LLM 兜底 10 次，超限标记 MANUAL_REVIEW

special_cases.rule: FORMAT_B_WITH_SUMMARY 文档：只读取最后一个 SUPPLEMENT SUMMARY 汇总段，忽略各分页行项，彻底避免 supplement overlap
Left 和 Right 同一 location 的相同操作（如 Replace Front Door Left/Right）保留为两条独立操作，耗材各自计算
Incl. 行对应的操作已包含在主操作内，跳过不重复提取

stage_10_metadata_extraction._comment: 第十步：从 PDF 头部提取车辆信息元数据

vin.label: VIN (no I O Q letters)
vin.note: VIN 不含 I, O, Q 三个字母

year_make_model.strategy: Find 4-digit year (19xx/20xx) adjacent to recognized make keyword

point_of_impact.label: Used to infer primary damage zone for context scoring

known_panels_for_consumables._comment: 触发耗材的 panel/location 白名单

operation_consumable_trigger_matrix._comment: 操作 + 部位 => 是否触发耗材匹配 material_logic.csv

error_patterns._comment: 已知容易误判的模式，解析时需特别检查

common_mistakes.description: Group Heading 行被误识别为操作（全大写、无动词）
common_mistakes.fix: 跳过，更新 activeGroup 上下文

common_mistakes.description: Line Note 中的 drop 或 rope 被忽略，非耗材操作被计入
common_mistakes.fix: 必须在确定 canonical 前先检查 Line Notes 列

common_mistakes.description: Incl. 行与主操作行重复计算
Paint/Labor Overlap 扣减行被当作独立操作
common_mistakes.fix: negative labor + overlap in description => SKIP_OVERLAP_ADJUSTMENT

common_mistakes.description: with Summary 文档中各 Supplement 分页行被重复计入
common_mistakes.fix: FORMAT_B_WITH_SUMMARY: 只读 SUPPLEMENT SUMMARY 部分

common_mistakes.description: 手动行（# 符号）被当作 MOTOR 标准操作对待
common_mistakes.fix: 标记 source=manual，confidence -= 1，走 MEDIUM 路径校验

common_mistakes.description: 被修改过的 DB 行（* 符号）canonical 可能不准
Add If Required 条件追加项被误当作必然操作
common_mistakes.fix: 标记为 conditional，不默认触发耗材，需结合 VIN/options 判断

common_mistakes.description: 未涂装保险杠的底漆准备工序未被识别
common_mistakes.fix: bumper R&R + unprimed marker => 触发 bumper_cover_unprimed 耗材规则

common_mistakes.description: 带折旧扣减的行（B20%）未记录 betterment
common_mistakes.fix: 检测 description 中 B 后跟数字和百分号 => 记录 betterment_pct 至 source_metadata

common_mistakes.description: 玻璃 R&I 操作被计入耗材
common_mistakes.fix: glass_panels 类型操作一律不触发耗材，见 operation_consumable_trigger_matrix

motor_guide_panel_included_lists._comment: 从 MOTOR Guide to Estimating 提取的每类面板 Included 操作列表。Included = 已包含在 R&R 时间内，不重复计算。

included: Lock and cylinder assembly if necessary
not_included: Bonded glass removal from damaged door shell

front_bumper_cover_rr.special_note: Unprimed bumper preparation (mold-release agent removal, priming) is NOT INCLUDED in R&R time and must be added separately.
included: Energy absorber when mounted to cover
Valance panel if mounted to bumper
not_included: Bumper brackets/frame rail extensions if mounted to frame rail
Energy absorber if mounted to frame rail
Valance panel not mounted to bumper

included: Cornering lamps if mounted to fender
Side repeater lamp if mounted to fender
Grind fill and smooth welded seams up to 150 grit
Rivet removal and installation if required
Rivet removal and installation if required
Included parts as listed in footnote for each chapter
not_included: See ESTIMATED WORK TIME PREMISE DOES NOT INCLUDE section

caching_strategy._comment: 运行时缓存策略，减少重复计算和 LLM 调用

rules.rule: 对 PDF 文本计算 SHA-256 hash，相同 hash 直接复用上次解析结果，不重新执行
本规则文件和 material_logic.csv / material_info.csv 在服务启动时一次性加载内存，请求期间不重读文件
相同的 group_heading + suspect_line 组合缓存 LLM 响应，有效期 24 小时
规则文件 _meta.version 变更时清除所有缓存，强制重新解析
